scope: Read-only reconciliation of nine historical Phase 2 reference contracts against actual enrichment/pilot production consumers. Not whole-branch closure, not an implementation or calibration migration.
original_inventory: All 131 original reconciliation tips already received bounded focal dispositions in batches 1–7; this follow-up does not alter that denominator or close broader residues.

records.wire_and_semantic_differences: Reference combines project/run/artifact SHA/raw/diff/occurrence identity, source kind, pointer, address kind and quality in one object. Current SourceLocation contains project-owned IDs and line/excerpt data; RunView/Guard supply outer identity. Hash prefix and occurrence recipes differ, so old IDs cannot be aliases. Pilot ObsRef/Nav are separate source/RVA contracts.
records.residual_obligation: Confirmed UI omission: current jump_signal bypasses existing live validator. Reference p-code/raw-json locators are not automatically supported by enrichment SourceLocation; no invented conversion.
records.disposition: Explicit incompatible reference wire shape; retain current versioned contract and listed behavior; no wholesale port

pilot_boundary.inputs: collect._signal_sets loads/computes B1 SignalSets; B1Evidence emits tool-reported code shape observations from Ghidra origin. It does not consume attention/1 or contextual numeric scores.
pilot_boundary.classification: pilot/1 is ordinal mechanism/class with explicit gates, component independence and tie-aware ordering; STRONG_REACHABLE is False, AssignedMechanism excludes strong.
pilot_boundary.future_tie_note: pilot/ranking.py states the plan attention-rank tie preference has no supplying source yet; current exact tie behavior is candidate_key order, preserved.

confirmed_gap.state: Existing documented open contract boundary reproduced; source unchanged
confirmed_gap.historical_scope_note: docs/specs/enrichment-hardening-backlog.md explicitly deferred UI wiring to its owner.
confirmed_gap.reachability: Authored checksum-valid derived row through real pipeline publication, project close/reopen, real MainWindow load and actual code cursor selection; invalid excerpt/side/run each reaches reveal_lines.

qualification.scope: 11 inspected current enrichment/UI/pilot test files; authored fixtures, source-only Python child import/schema checks, offscreen Qt.
Exact original reference test bytes; existing runtime JSON Schema dependency, no installation/network/processes in tests; no semantic or runtime compatibility claim.
Nine reference-valid wire objects refused by their current projection, plus public snapshot parser typed refusal. Refusal is expected and protective.
Actual persisted/reopened GUI navigation defect and pure-validator/valid-navigation positives.

limits: No production or existing test changes.
Original batch7 missing-jsonschema collection error and later historical 23-pass run retained with original source attribution.
No live CVE fetch, target execution, native engine, compiler, Windows package, frozen application, calibration run or manual desktop acceptance.
Current-source tests do not turn reference schema examples into operational authenticity or complete supplied-schema support.
No percentages or additive coverage totals; gates overlap and have different purposes.
